title: Mexican Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A twist on the classic grilled cheese, this Mexican version is filled with the flavors of melted cheese, spicy pulled pork, and a crunchy crust.
instructions: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place one slice of bread, buttered side down, in a pan over medium heat.
Top with a slice of cheese, some pulled pork, and a sprinkle of robata.
Place the second slice of bread, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwich over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
